summary: Test suite covers core label-assignment logic (glob matching, rule priority, exclusive groups) and basic errors, but critically lacks: (1) act integration tests—the task explicitly requires all tests run through GitHub Actions via `act`, with output captured to `act-result.txt` and exit codes validated; this is entirely absent. (2) Fixture files—Workflow.Tests.ps1 asserts `fixtures/label-rules.json` and `fixtures/changed-files.json` exist in the repo but provides no code to create them; these tests will fail. (3) GITHUB_OUTPUT handling—no tests verify the script writes to `$env:GITHUB_OUTPUT` in the Actions context. (4) Edge cases—no tests for paths with spaces/special characters, unicode filenames, malformed JSON, or large inputs. (5) Test infrastructure—no `run-act-tests.sh` or test runner mentioned in the task; no demonstration that the workflow actually executes end-to-end. The unit tests themselves are well-structured (good separation, clear names, appropriate fixtures), but the test suite is fundamentally incomplete for the stated requirements. Would catch regressions in label logic but not in GitHub Actions integration or robustness.
